description: This PHP source file defines the class InsideViewLogicHook, which implements logic for integration with InsideView within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for constructing specific URLs based on CRM entity data and rendering an embedded iframe for displaying InsideView information in the UI.

classes.name: InsideViewLogicHook
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate InsideView iframe URLs and render inside view UI components within SuiteCRM, based on CRM entity data and user context.

methods.name: handleFieldMap
methods.description: Generates URL parameter strings by mapping source bean properties to destination fields, supporting nested arrays for multiple source options.

methods.name: getAccountFrameUrl
methods.description: Constructs the InsideView URL for account entities, incorporating mapped account fields.

methods.name: getOpportunityFrameUrl
methods.description: Constructs the InsideView URL for opportunity entities.

methods.name: getLeadFrameUrl
methods.description: Constructs the InsideView URL for lead entities.

methods.name: getContactFrameUrl
methods.description: Constructs the InsideView URL for contact entities.

methods.name: showFrame
methods.description: Main method that responds to the event to render an iframe with InsideView data for the current CRM bean, based on user permissions and context.
